column2: PROP REFERENCE SHEET on a plain flat warm-cream #F6EDE2 background, items neatly spaced, no text: (1) the "4 little tasks" board — a small rectangular clay board with a sage frame and a hanging string, four square slots in a row each with a clay icon: a coral heart, a white-pink pill, a golden coin, a small house; show it twice: once with all slots empty, once with all four slots crossed out by a rose clay stripe; (2) a small round clay fish jar (clear-looking clay glass jar with a cork lid), shown empty and shown full of tiny orange clay fish; (3) three single tiny orange clay fish. 16:9 landscape.

FAMILY HANDS REFERENCE SHEET on a plain flat warm-cream #F6EDE2 background, three labelled-by-colour rows (no text): row 1 Mẹ — two adult hands in a sage-green knitted cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle, one holding a cream coffee cup, one pointing with an index finger; row 2 Ba — two adult hands in a navy-and-white striped shirt sleeve with a brown leather wristwatch, one holding a folded newspaper, one giving a thumbs-up; row 3 Bé — two small child hands in a mustard-yellow sleeve, one pointing, one holding a small tea cup. Only hands and forearms, no faces, no bodies. Handmade clay. 16:9 landscape.
